key.name: every-screen
key.summary: A top bar on every screen
key.description: With two screens or more, each screen has a top bar with the workspace it shows and the time.

key.name: peek
key.description: Pushing the pointer against the top edge of a screen with a fullscreen window brings the top bar down over it.

key.name: layout
key.summary: What the top bar holds, and where
key.description: The items of the main bar by their ids (logo, workspaces, tiling, clock, processor, memory, network, tray, clipboard, phone, shield, busy, keyboard, a11y, system, widget-NAME) in the lists left, center, right and hidden, in order. Empty: the bar as the image arranges it. An item no list names stays where it is; the clock and the system menu are never hidden.

key.name: position
key.description: top, or bottom, where its menus open upwards and a dock at the bottom sits above it.

key.name: autohide
key.description: The bar is hidden and gives its room to the windows; pushing the pointer against its edge brings it in.

key.name: size
key.description: compact (28 px), regular (32 px) or roomy (40 px), with its icons, the workspaces and the clock's pill scaled together. Touch mode's taller bar wins over each.
